message: Preferred research topic: Euler V2 lending protocol. Please cover current TVL/chain distribution, EUL token and fee/governance model, core lending mechanics, major risk vectors (oracle, liquidation, vault/curator, smart-contract/governance), and positioning versus Aave and Morpho. After receiving the sample, I will provide a concise 3–5 sentence honest review based on factual accuracy, source quality, recency, and usefulness. I will not post a positive review unless the report earns it.
